prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1435
Claimant:
Lawrence Delgado
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
6-13-24
First notice of loss received from the claimant's representing attorney, reporting a rear-end collision at a signalized
intersection with a wrist fracture to the claimant. Vehicle is drivable but has rear bumper and trunk damage.
6-23-24
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss. Coverage
verification complete with no issues noted.
6-25-24
Police report obtained. It places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of impact and matches the reported location
and general sequence of events.
7-2-24
Photos from the insured and the claimant's side were reviewed. They confirm the rear damage and the approximate
point of contact, though no independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision.
7-13-24
Reviewed the damage against the described impact speed and angle. Most of the rear structural damage is in line
with what was reported. A few older scratches on the lower bumper may predate this loss and will be noted
separately.
8-20-24
Spoke with the claimant through counsel. The account of how the collision occurred matches the initial statement
given at first notice, with no material differences in the sequence or details.
9-30-24
Medical records received. The wrist fracture is consistent with the mechanism of a rear-end impact of this type. No
prior injury to the same wrist or arm appears in the claimant's records or in the history provided.
10-23-24
Treatment began within a day of the collision and followed a typical course, including immobilization, orthopedic
follow-up, and physical therapy. Treating notes describe steady improvement.
11-3-24
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage occurred before the coverage start date. The prior-damage question
is limited to the few minor scratches already noted.
12-4-24
Sent request to the treating orthopedic provider for updated status and expected recovery timeline. Counsel was
copied on the request.
12-16-24
Updated medical report indicates the claimant has progressed well, with therapy visits decreasing in frequency as
range of motion returns. Treatment appears to be tapering as expected for this injury.
2-6-25
Reserve reviewed based on the current medical picture and repair estimate. File remains open pending final medical
update and resolution of the minor prior-damage note on the bumper.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
